customer_reply_templates.text:
Please help us confirm if the gate opener runs randomly only when the TC148 push button is connected. If so, please do the following tests for further diagnosis.
Isolate the TC148 Wall Switch
Disconnect all wired accessories from the control board except the TC148 wall switch to see how it goes.
If problem disappears, may I ask if you also connected other wired accessories to the “push button” terminals. If yes, please use shield wires and combining cap to connect them. Below is the link of How to Connect Multiple Accessories to a Shared Terminal on a TOPENS Gate Opener Control Board for your reference.
If the problem remains, please go on the following steps.
2. Check the Wiring Distance and Cable Type
Generally, long wire length or poor cable quality may cause signal interference. May I ask what distance between the control board and the TC148 push button and what gauge the wire is. In a normal case, please use the well-shielded 2C*22 AWG (2 x 0.3 mm2) (at least) cable to connect TC148 to the circuit board. Besides, the cable is not recommended to exceed 15 meters. If you use extension cables, please disconnect the extension cable and connect only the original short cables coming with the TC148 switch to see how it works.
3. Check for Electrical Interference
If the problem persists, there might be interference. You can try to connect the “COM” terminal of the control board to the ground. Please do it referring to the following steps.
Drive an iron nail (or other metal part) in the ground.
Connect the “COM” terminal on the control board and the nail with an electric wire.
If all the tests cannot help, you can replace a TC148 to have a try.
Note:
For advanced users only: Use a multimeter to test the switch for continuity.
With the switch not pressed → Should be open circuit (no continuity)
With the switch pressed → Should be closed circuit (continuity)
If the switch tests as always closed or erratic, it is defective.
Final resolution: Replace the TC148 wall switch.
